evidence.test_name: R1: main package contains no bundled official preset plugin copy
R2: resolveChain uses enabled plugin registry entries and rejects unregistered presets
R3: upgrade records reproducibility metadata when provider completion uses a git source
R4: upgrade migrates manifestless legacy presets using provider parent scan and chapters
R5: @presets includes resolve through project root, config type order, and leaf-to-root chain order
R6: plugin preset DataSources use public pathMatch container APIs
R7: main test runner discovery excludes bundled and external official preset tests
R8: main contract tests avoid actual official preset names as implementation fixtures
R9: upgrade keeps --dry-run stable and rejects unsupported arguments with non-zero status
